summary: Phase 2 (Doctor Referral CRM, Campaign Broadcasting, Hospital Profile auto-import) tested end-to-end. Backend: 24/25 pytest tests pass (one real bug found in /campaigns/{id}/send). Frontend: all new routes (/doctors, /doctors/:id, /campaigns, /campaigns/:id, Settings hospital profile, Patients new-patient with referring doctor) render correctly with full data. Hospital website auto-import from https://cureandcarehospital.in worked: 11 departments, 14 services, 6 FAQs populated. Sidebar has Referral CRM + Campaigns nav items.

critical.issue: Returns 500 (Internal Server Error) when any audience patient has department=None. Root cause: server.py line 1082 calls c['message_body'].replace('{department}', p.get('department', '')) but p.get('department', '') returns None (not '') when the key exists with a None value. str.replace requires a string argument. Fix: use (p.get('department') or '') instead of p.get('department', ''). Same risk for {name} replacement.

action_items: Fix POST /api/campaigns/{id}/send 500 when patient.department is None. In server.py line 1082, change `.replace('{department}', p.get('department', ''))` to `.replace('{department}', p.get('department') or '')` and similarly for `{name}`. This is the only failing test out of 25.
(Optional) Add cleanup teardown for TEST_ prefixed doctors/campaigns to avoid noise in /doctors list across test runs.

rca of the issue: Bug: POST /api/campaigns/{id}/send → 500. Reproduction: create a campaign with empty audience filter (matches all patients), then POST /campaigns/{id}/send. Some patients in seed have department=None (e.g., the 2 TEST_PRefDoc/TEST_RefPatient created by Phase 2 tests). Trace: TypeError: replace() argument 2 must be str, not None at server.py:1082 → `c['message_body'].replace('{department}', p.get('department', ''))`. `p.get('department', '')` returns None when the key exists with a None value (dict.get's default only applies if key is missing). Mitigation: replace `p.get('department', '')` with `(p.get('department') or '')` and `p.get('name', '')` with `(p.get('name') or '')`. One-line change.
